verdict: Single Facebook campaign spent $2,330 this period with no lead data visible to judge results.
diagnosis: Daily spend collapsed from a $13.63 average to $3.85 in the latest period, suggesting budget throttling or campaign fatigue on the PCOS/Postpartum ads.

signals.headline: Total spend hit $2,330 this period
signals.detail: All budget flowed through one Facebook lead campaign targeting PCOS and postpartum audiences. No diversification across accounts or channels.

signals.headline: Daily spend fell to $3.85 latest
signals.detail: Down from a $13.63 daily average across the period. Either budgets were cut or delivery is starving.

signals.headline: 346,446 impressions delivered this period
signals.detail: Reach is strong but no lead volume, cost per lead, or conversion data is available to judge quality.

signals.headline: Zero data across 4 other channels
signals.detail: Google Business Profile, organic social, CRM pipeline, and top performers are all blank. Blind spots on where leads actually land.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: <cite index="9-6,9-7,9-8">Budget gyms typically see $8-$15 per lead, mid-range facilities $15-$30, and premium or boutique studios $25-$50.</cite> <cite index="6-5">Fitness holds the highest Facebook conversion rate at 14.29%.</cite>

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: <cite index="1-11">September and November 2025 were the months the fitness sector ran above market, roughly 25% and 19% higher.</cite> Expect elevated cost per lead versus summer lows right now.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Studios winning on community, not acquisition
competitor.body: <cite index="18-17,18-18,18-19">Studios saw cancellations drop 6% last year while gyms rose 8%, with community-led studios outperforming.</cite> <cite index="12-14">Pilates now represents over 43% of primary studio modalities.</cite>

recommendations.title: Connect lead tracking to see cost per lead
recommendations.detail: Spend without lead counts is flying blind. Consider connecting the Facebook lead form to a CRM or spreadsheet so cost per lead can be measured against the $25-$50 boutique benchmark.

recommendations.title: Investigate why daily spend dropped to $3.85
recommendations.detail: Check whether budgets were manually cut, the campaign is delivery-limited, or creative fatigue is throttling reach. September is a high-intent month worth protecting spend on.

recommendations.title: Test a speed-to-lead follow-up system
recommendations.detail: Leads contacted within 5 minutes are 9x more likely to convert. Worth exploring an automated text or call within minutes of a PCOS/Postpartum form submission.
